title: eludite.view.show input
description: Show and activate a tool window (View menu, e.g. View > Workspace) or a document tab. A closed tool window reopens where it was; an auto-hidden one slides out; a tabbed one becomes the active tab of its group. `web_browser` (View > Other Windows > Web Browser) opens the Web Browser window as a document tab, as Visual Studio does.

id.description: Tool window id (e.g. workspace, properties, error_list, output, toolbox, git_changes, web_browser) or document tab id.
